news.text: 🤵🏻‍♂🧐 "#Juventus, the coaching situation:👔/👨‍🦲 #Conte wants a project where he can build, with the bianconeri there has never been a real and official contact to date. There is trust in #Spalletti, who has never been set risk, though there is a need to stabilize results. From this perspective, he should always be kept an eye on, though without immediate developments;🇮🇹 #Inzaghi has not yet decided to leave #AlHilal, but it cannot be ruled out. In the event of an exit, he would welcome a return to Italy. La Vecchia Signora should not be underestimated if they find themselves in a situation of change. However, it is not (yet) the time for meetings and negotiations: total focus on winning in Sa

🇮🇹✅ "Signing #Vicario permanently for less than €10M is an almost unmissable deal, because he is a strong goalkeeper - he has proven it with his performances, with important saves and he very often manages to keep the team standing. Spending that money on him is worth it: those at la Continassa consider him an opportunity not to be missed."[Alfredo Pedullà - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇫🇷⚠️ "#Juventus breaks the hesitation and prepares the assault for #Bakola: #Carnevali has a €25/30M plan in mind to beat out the strong English competition. The idea is to close the deal as early as January and then leave him at #Sassuolo until June. To convince the neroverdi and lower the financial outlay, the management is also considering including a player in exchange (#Adzic in pole position)."[Giovanni Albanese - Instagram via @juventusinsidernews]
.@juventusfc, #Spalletti aims to recover Nico #González, #Conceição and #Cambiaso for #Venezia. #Yildiz will be back in December.[Di Marzio]

🇮🇹❓ "I have the feeling that #Cambiaso's situation is now difficult to salvage. If the right pieces fall into place, something could happen, but it will also be necessary to understand what his wishes and those of his entourage are. It is not a settled situation yet, but it is an option to keep in consideration ahead of January."[Romeo Agresti - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇳🇴⁉️ "#Sorloth-#Juventus: to date, there are still no communication between the parties. The bianconeri are evaluating a physical center-forward, but we are still in the realm of ifs and buts: the situation is completely developing. He has realized that he is also losing ground in #Simeone's eyes, but it will remain to be seen whether la Vecchia Signora will be alone in the race and how the scenario will evolve."[Matteo Moretto - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

👀 #Juventus has already begun scouting the goalkeeper landscape months in advance, with the idea of finding the ideal partner to accompany Guglielmo #Vicario.THE FIRST NAME ▪️ Lorenzo #Palmisani, #Frosinone goalkeeper, with whom he just renewed his contract▫️ He has been on the bianconero management's radar for quite some time▪️ It is not ruled out that #Juve could attempt a move as early as January, to then leave him on loan at #Frosinone until the end of the season, just as they did in the past with the #Gatti transfer. THE ALTERNATIVES▫️ Pedro #Morisco, from #Coritiba, who has entered the Brasil National Team's circle▪️ Stanislav #Agkatsev, #Krasnodar's number oneTHE GOALKEEPER SITUATION
✅‼️Rayan #AïtNouri continues to be of great interest to #Juventus[Mirko Di Natale]

⚠️‼️#Juventus's primary midfield target in January will be Pierre-Emile #Højbjerg. #Fiorentina is also interested in him. The bianconero club will work on the deal structure and on #OM's currently excessive demands, as they value him at around €12mln and want to free up wage space.@TUTTOJUVE_COM[Mirko Di Natale]

❌ Francisco #Conceição has no intention of leaving #Juventus. The bianconero club, despite some rumors circulating in the last few hours, is not planning to sell him in January. Luciano #Spalletti really likes the player.[Mirko Di Natale]
